name: cadence
title: Proposal cadence
question: How much of the fee load is set by how often a fund trades, rather than by the rates?
note: Management fee accrues only while a proposal is open, so cadence x duration is what turns a rate into a bill. 24 x 21 days is 138% of the year, capped at 100%: such a fund pays the full headline management rate. Note that script/Deploy.s.sol ships MAX_STRATEGY_DAYS at 14, below the factory's 30-day ceiling, so the 21-day cells assume that deploy-time parameter is raised.
